criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: One rendered world in lastLight with real casts; 1, 7 and 9 hold. Slide 3's pack reads as a brown slatted crate beside a mannequin; 4 a bar chart of slats in a void; 5 a flat top-down grating on mud with a flat brown open stretch; 8 a mannequin at a sawhorse table in an empty bay; 6 mostly mid-tone caliche with a dead band and a small far frame.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One site and one light with a declared camera move and the ember line on 1, 6, 7 and 9; slides 3 and 4 sit in a black void and 8 in a bay with no pads.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, but the cooling claim stretches its source: the page 4 chart is N/A responses as a percent of answers by category, where cooling is the highest rate, and by count cooling ranks fourth of five. Slide 7 sets the cooling sentence under later projects while page 2 ties undecided cooling to pre-2028 Medium Loads. Slide 9 picks the December 17th meeting while the calendar also lists December 11th, and no source links either to the report.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and the next date are named; no county; no action for a Texan; slide 8 moves to an unexplained separate process; the strongest form of the stake is left out.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: A choppy cover headline; slide 2 pays at once; 6 turns to cooling; 9 closes on dates; slide 8 is a different population and cuttable.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and careful; reads as a regulatory digest with N/A as a verb, Batch Zero and NOIE unglossed.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No. 60 on October 25th used the same instrument with an answered versus unanswered concept and a copper bus bar relief; empty bolted pads repeat nos. 59 and 69; the close outside a gate repeats nos. 62, 68 and 75. A new event under a different item, so not a topic hard fail.

hard_fails: An unverified fact presented as verified and refuted by the run's own fetched source: slide 1's dek, slide 6's headline and dek, the caption and the document title say cooling was the largest share of the unanswered questions. ercot_ci_rfi.txt page 5 prints N/A counts by category, A 404 and 689, B 944 and 1,697, C 916 and 1,853, D cooling 463 and 1,077, E 1,122 and 2,389, so cooling holds about 1,540 of 11,554 N/A answers, fourth of five; page 4 shows cooling first only by rate. ERCOT's sentence is ambiguous and its chart shows it means the rate.
one_sentence_fix: Rebuild the cooling spine on the rate the table shows and strike every largest share, biggest blank and led the unanswered line from the title, cover, frame 6 and caption.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Four big cooling pads beside an open trench stretch that stands for the whole unanswered share; mid-tone caliche, a dead band, a small far frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Show the claim as a rate and tighten the pool so the caliche outside falls to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The pack reads as a brown slatted crate under flat light beside a mannequin.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Fully metallic copper at roughness about 0.25 raked by the low left key; the worker a rim-lit silhouette.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin at a sawhorse table in an empty bay; the folder stack one block.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop to the table top under the work light so the stack's edges fill a third of the frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A bar chart of slats on black with no world.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A low three-quarter with the packs receding along the dunnage and the primer columns behind in the pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat top-down grating on a muddy field; the open stretch flat brown.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A grazing key, an ember far wall and darker caliche.
